text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, of all things...
—I completely forgot.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The next candidates for the strongest aren't just from the older generation.
That's right, "she" is here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Erasing her presence during the race
and sneaking smoothly up the field before you know it...
her running is seriously insane."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: Yeah, they really stood out in the Kikuka Sho too.
Yeah, she really stood out in the Kikuka Sho, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring). We need to keep an eye on Narita Top Road, of course, but just as frightening is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Manhattan Cafe.
Among her peers, she is an undeniable
long-distance specialist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might have had a mediocre run in her previous GII race,
but it wouldn't be surprising if she pulled off an upset today.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Cafe.
We've got... kind of a weird relationship, don't we?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We make small talk, but we never talk heart-to-heart.
I don't know a single damn thing about you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ain't it about time you showed me? What's under that veil of yours.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Spit it out.
What the hell are you chasing after?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "You're always going on about your pals and whatnot. What does that even mean? What's your goal here?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand the point of your question.
I only want to catch up to my "friend."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"She'll definitely be up ahead in this race too.
That's why... today, of all days...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, is that so?
Looks like you're playing dumb right to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. We won't know just by talking.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I will see for myself through our running.
At the Tenno Sho (Spring). On this grand stage—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just what it is
that you're chasing so recklessly!
